package.name: block_sorter
package.description: Human-robot collaborative block sorting demo for UR5e + MoveIt2. Watches /planning_scene for three blocks. When the human picks one (a block disappears from the scene), the robot picks one of the remaining two and moves it to its sort destination. Uses the same hand_exclusion_zone collision-avoidance pattern as bt_action_server to stop mid-motion when the human's hand intersects the planned path.
